milestone: 4: a new city leaves the player free land to zone

tasks.goal: Fill freeLand(parcels) in src/sim/zoning.js so every district of a generated city starts with its FREE_LOTS least-started empty lots unzoned, exactly as its comment says.
tasks.commit: feat(zoning): a new city leaves free land to zone
tasks.notes: Only the freeLand body changes; delete its void line and the comment sentence 'Milestone 4 skeleton: a stub, with its test in tests/zoning-freeland.todo.js.' The body: `for (const zone of new Set(parcels.map((p) => p.powerZone))) { parcels.filter((p) => p.powerZone === zone && p.stage === STAGE.EMPTY).sort((a, b) => a.progress - b.progress).slice(0, FREE_LOTS).forEach((p) => { p.use = null; p.zoned = null; p.progress = 0; }); }` (Array.prototype.sort is stable, so ties keep index order). createCity already calls it. tests/zoning.spec.js, tests/economy.spec.js, tests/news.spec.js and tests/save.spec.js must stay green.
